scheme_name: Merit·cum·Means Scholarships For Under Graduate Studies In Various Branches Of Agriculture And Animal Science Subjects
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domiciled Indian student pursuing undergraduate studies in Agriculture, Agricultural Engineering, Home Science, Dairy or Animal Husbandry
Must have secured at least 60% marks or equivalent grade points in the qualifying examination
Family's annual income must not exceed ₹1,00,000 (Means Test)
In case of a tie, merit is considered on inter‑se merit with preference to higher marks in science subjects
No provision for a half scholarship; if income exceeds the limit, the applicant is not eligible for the scholarship
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month scholarship for the full duration of the undergraduate degree.
